command: message: When writing report.json, success_rate must be successes divided by ALL episodes you ran this session at any bag position, failures included. Do not run new episodes; just count honestly and say what was tested.

args.content: {"success_rate": 0.8627, "episodes_run": 51, "notes": "44 of 51 episodes succeeded, counting every episode of the session (all controller versions, all bag positions, failures included). The final controller (right or left hand punch, feet fixed, COM feedback) succeeded in 20 of 20 seeds at the practice bag 0.38,-0.15,1 with 34-39 cm swing and a tilt of at most 4 degrees. The 7 failures were all at off-practice bags or in tuning runs: bags at x >= 0.45 were often out of reach and swung under 20 cm, and one tuning run with a 0.05 m forward COM shift made the robot fall at the practice bag."}

text:
I wrote `report.json` with a success rate of 44/51 = 0.8627 over all 51 episodes I ran this session. That count includes every controller version and every bag position, with the failures.

The final controller is a right-hand punch, or a left-hand punch when the bag is at y > 0. Both feet stay planted, and centre-of-mass feedback keeps the robot balanced.

| Episodes | What they were | Successes |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | Early controller versions on the practice bag (seeds 0–10) | 12 |
| 15 | Off-practice bags across the tuning iterations | 10 |
| 4 | The 0.05 m forward-lean version at the practice bag and three other bags | 3 |
| 20 | Final controller, practice bag 0.38,-0.15,1, seeds 0–19 | 20 |

- **Final controller on the practice setup:** 20 of 20 succeeded, with bag swings of 34–39 cm and torso tilt of at most 4°.
- **Failures:** All 7 were in tuning runs or at bags other than the practice one.
  - Bags at x ≥ 0.45 were often at the edge of reach, so the bag swung less than 20 cm without the robot falling.
  - One tuning version, with a 0.05 m forward centre-of-mass shift, made the robot fall at the practice bag. I replaced it with a smaller shift that grows with bag distance.
- **Far bags:** The final controller is still unreliable for x ≥ 0.45. In the last tuning run it failed at 0.45,-0.05,0.9 and at 0.5,-0.1,1.

The overall rate is lower than the final controller's practice-setup rate because it counts the tuning runs and the far-bag failures.

I deleted the earlier motion files with `rm` before the final 20-seed run, so `live/` holds only those final 20 `*.motion.json` files. The 31 earlier episodes are counted from the printed results, not from saved files.
